Step aboard this immersive spaceship adventure that is “quite simply the nearest you will ever get to being in space” (★★★★★ London Theatre1).

This intergalactic expedition combines the best of theatre, cutting-edge gaming technology, escape rooms and features live actors to bring to life “a sci-fi fan’s dream come true!” (★★★★★ Clonestar Pod) without the need for VR or wearable tech.

JOIN THE OFFICIAL DISCORD:

All personnel are hereby invited to join the Official UCN Communications Channel (Discord) for ongoing inter-fleet coordination. Engage with fellow officers and crew in secure comms to:

  • Coordinate upcoming deployment schedules and Mess visits
  • Discuss controversies, emerging theories, and political developments
  • Exchange classified intel (within clearance parameters of course)
  • Receive exclusive updates on fleet news, operations, and sanctioned events by the UCN
Operational comms are live. Join now and stay informed. 

Go to Discord

Become a UCN Supporter

Support Bridge Command with a monthly donation and help us to continue delivering missions, create new content, and welcome new officers to the UCN. Supporters also receive an exclusive uniform patch.

Become a Supporter

Find us in Vauxhall, London

Bridge Command is based in Vauxhall, just minutes from Vauxhall Station. If you’re looking for things to do in Vauxhall or the immersive theatre in London, our starship simulator is ready to launch.

Book Book Now
Book Book Now
  1. Home
  2. Corporate Bookings

Bridge Command offers a genre-defying immersive experience where your team steps aboard a starship to work together as its crew in dynamic, high-stakes scenarios.

Ideal for corporate events, team-building activities, or group socials, this intergalactic adventure promotes communication, problem-solving, and collective decision-making: all the while creating a one-of-a-kind experience that leaves a lasting impression on your team.

  • Strengthen Teamwork

    Explore uncharted galaxies and overcome thrilling challenges as a cohesive crew, promoting effective communication and alignment toward shared objectives.

  • Develop decision-making

    Immerse your team in a highstakes environment brought to life with advanced technology and live actors. Every choice shapes the mission, building confidence, refining decision-making, and nurturing leadership abilities.

  • Encourage Collaboration

    Solve complex challenges collectively, enhancing relationships through innovative thinking.

  • Relax and Recharge

    After the mission, debrief at the bar with a well deserved drink. Take time to reflect on your teamwork and celebrate the successes of your mission.

DON’T JUST HOST ANOTHER CORPORATE EVENT: BECOME THE CREW OF YOUR OWN STARSHIP.

AS PLAYED BY

Rate Card

We can run a number of missions for your team depending on the size of your crew. If you have fewer than 4 people, we may be able to help by providing extra crew members for you, either as actors or by connecting you with other smaller bookings. Contact us if this is what you require.

  • 4-14

    With this crew size you will all be working together in one ship.

    £999 +VAT  |  2 Hour Experience

    Contact Bookings

  • 15-28

    Across two ships, you can pit your colleagues against one another in direct combat or with leaderboards.  Or seek to work together as one big team.

    £1,998 +VAT |  2 Hour Experience

    Contact Bookings

  • 29-56

    Across two ships, you will be divided into teams and will play your missions in rotation. There will also be ancillary activities organised in the bar whilst not on active ship duty.

    £3,996 +VAT |  4 Hour Experience

    Contact Bookings

  • 12 People

    A full day, starting at 9am and finishing at 5pm. This is a specifically developed formal team building event written for exactly 12 people. Ideal for new or existing teams. Further details available by email.

    £5,994 +VAT | 8 HOUR EXPERIENCE

    Contact Bookings

Prices shown accurate until end of August 2026. Prices will rise in September. Contact Bridge Command for pricing in September and beyond. Pre-September prices above work out at £71.36 per participant.

Corporate FAQs

 

Can we customise the experience?

Yes, we’re happy to tailor the experience to fit your event goal with advance notice. Email bookings@bridgecommand.space to check if we can accommodate this for you.

Is AV equipment available for presentations?

We have AV facilities for speeches or presentations before or after your mission. Let us know if you need this when booking.

Can we add branding or company specific elements?

We’re happy to discuss adding branding touches or customizing parts of the experience to suit your corporate identity. Email us to isolate the details.

Can we run an open tab at the bar?

Absolutely! The venue has a bar which will be open to you for as long as you like, both before and after your booking and if you would like to set up a bar tab, we’re happy to arrange that. You can settle the tab after the event or we can invoice you.

Do you provide food?

For corporate bookings of 14 or more crew members, we can provide catering with advance notice. Just email us for menu options and details.
